title: A desktop made of your photos
summary: Arrange photos into desktop collages, save favorite setups, and reuse a look across widgets. Reference tools and arrangement undo make it easier to experiment while keeping your original photos.
details: Install the universal Apple Silicon and Intel app with Developer ID signing and Apple notarization.
Group desktop photos into collages with adjustable spacing, materials, labels and fonts. Hidden photos no longer distort visible collage bounds or placement.
Undo and redo alignment, distribution, dragging, resizing, and moves into or out of a collage.
Save named desktop setups, switch between them, restore the previous desktop, and recover the most recently removed widgets after relaunch.
Compare six photo looks with a live preview, then fine-tune them in Adjust. Copy and paste appearance without replacing images, positions or reference edits. Find editing tools from the Tools panel.
Crop, rotate, flip or grayscale your photos without rewriting managed originals. Add reference notes and source links, with a fitted preview of your edits.
Keep a slideshow linked to a Photos collection, with managed local copies and recovery guidance when Photos access is denied.
Use consistent confirmation dialogs and direct links to the relevant Photos and Screen Recording permission panes.
Try six editable examples with bundled artwork and guided next steps. Photo Tools can replace the sample image while keeping its look.
Find app-wide controls in reorganized Preferences and Privacy panels, and search Photos albums in a compact picker.
Limited usage and weekly configuration statistics are disclosed in Privacy and the Security & Privacy policy. Photos and personal content stay local.
